record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare AURA_WHEEL: Morpeko and Morpeko Hangry (both 3 stars, maxPP 50, range 1, passive HUNGER_SWITCH). The strategy is shared; the form is chosen at cast time from pokemon.name, so each unit casts the same code and flips to the other form.
record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL damage on the cast target (raw 20/40/60/120 by caster stars: 60 for both 3-star units), plus three self effects: the caster toggles form (MORPEKO <-> MORPEKO_HANGRY by name/index), gains +10 speed for the fight, and has its attack cooldown reset to 500 divided by the speed factor (computed after the +10). The form change is visible to code that checks pokemon.name, e.g. the triple-attack branch applies paralysis for MORPEKO and wound for MORPEKO_HANGRY.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target passed to the strategy; the form change, speed and cooldown apply to the caster
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.resolution: Assigns pokemon.name and pokemon.index; when switching to Hangry and a player reference exists, MORPEKO_HANGRY is added to pokemonsPlayed. Stats, stars, items and PP are not touched by this code (the entity keeps its own fields).

effects.scaling: requested +10 with apBoost 0 and no crit, so AP and crit do not change it. Applied: Big Eater Belt holder gets floor(10 x 1.25) = 12; Twist Band does not alter a positive value; the clamp keeps speed within 0..300 (MAX_SPEED); not permanent, so it lasts for this fight only. The MELMETAL passive branch of addSpeed does not apply (declared passive is HUNGER_SWITCH).
effects.resolution: requested +10 -> applied after applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff / applyTwistBandBuff and the clamp. Each cast adds again (no cap other than 300).

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost passed explicitly as true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false). The damage is requested after the speed gain, but speed does not enter the formula.
effects.resolution: Requested = table value; applied damage is intermediate: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, minimum 1, among other steps. Blocked completely (no damage) if the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce; the form change, speed gain and cooldown reset still happen. The takenDamage return value is not read.

effects.scaling: cooldown = round(500 / (0.4 + speed x 0.007)) with the caster's speed after the +10 (and after a Big Eater Belt bonus or the 300 clamp, if relevant).
effects.resolution: Set at the end of process, replacing the cooldown the attacking state set before the cast; the next action therefore comes sooner than a normal attack slot.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; both units are 3 stars at the factory, so index 3 (60) applies; 20 and 40 are not reachable at the factory star count, 120 is the fallback for 4+ stars.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target (the unit must be in range of it to cast, since requiresTarget is true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Two modes selected by pokemon.name: a cast always flips the form (MORPEKO -> MORPEKO_HANGRY -> MORPEKO ...). Each cast adds another +10 speed (cumulative within the fight) and does the same damage in both forms. The cast condition tests the name exactly against MORPEKO; any other name takes the else branch.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 60 (3 stars), speed +10, cooldown base 500. Requested = raw; applied speed = 10 (12 with Big Eater Belt, clamped to 300 total); applied damage = 60 x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) in handleDamage; cooldown uses the speed after the buff.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, minimum of 1 and the protect / skydiving / magicBounce block were read here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
unresolved: The passive HUNGER_SWITCH declared by both units has its own passive record in the queue; whether it also toggles the form was not read here, so the interaction with this cast is unverified
Which game systems besides the triple-attack branch read pokemon.name (client display, scribbles.ts, evolution/stat lookup by index) was not enumerated; the code here only assigns name and index
Whether a different stats block is loaded when the name changes: this strategy assigns no stats, and no other code was read for that
Consulted: addSpeed with applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff / applyTwistBandBuff, resetCooldown, handleSpecialDamage, handleDamage SPECIAL defence step and minimum, sibling AIR_SLASH record
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
